pure_persistence: Explicit checkpoint reuse only; no filesystem, database, clock, RNG, environment, network, subprocess, credentials, model, or tool access.
equivalence: A first public M2 pass establishes exact rejection precedence only; its successful payload does not construct the candidate. Candidate construction then precedes a second public M2 differential comparison, and every accepted fixpoint_result is canonical-byte equal.
checkpoint_bindings: rule bundle digest and through logical time
complete exact materialization and materialization digest
receipt_bindings: two excluded public M2 full-recompute calls
internal_dependency_nonclaim: Pinned M2 private helpers are an adjunct implementation dependency only and do not modify, own, or stabilize M2 internals.
